{{Quote|He said that together we would bring a stunning defeat down on the Rebel Alliance. A victory they would never recover from. ''[&hellip;]'' That's why I endorsed his credentials. ''[&hellip;]'' Don't you see? He was going to bring us victory. ''[&hellip;]''<s></s>''"<br />"''You endorsed&mdash;You ''knew'' he was a fraud?''"<br />"''Victory over the Rebellion. ''[&hellip;]'' And then &hellip; it would be Admiral &hellip; Drusan &hellip; Admiral &hellip; Admiral &hellip;|Captain Calo Drusan and Commander Gilad Pellaeon, with the former dying|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Calo Drusan''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] that served the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Seeking a decisive victory against the Rebellion and a promotion to [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], Drusan allowed the supposed [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo&mdash;in truth, the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]&mdash;aboard the ''Chimaera'' so that Esva could help him defeat the Rebels and therefore, bring the captain his desired promotion. Drusan claimed to his senior [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]], including [[third bridge officer]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], that "Odo" had been sent to the ''Chimaera'' by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and discouraged his crew's efforts to identify the Imperial lord in an attempt to conceal the warlord's true identity.

Drusan, along with Odo, commanded the Star Destroyer during a [[Engagement at Teptixii|battle]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that resulted in the retreat of [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|one]] of Esva's attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and the arrival of the ''Chimaera'' and Imperial [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. There, Esva made his move, sabotaging Drusan's [[Warship/Legends|warship]] and incapacitating the captain, who in his final moments revealed his [[Treason/Legends|treachery]] to Pellaeon.

==Biography==
===A profitable alliance===
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Calo drusan [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Drusan allied himself with the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], who promised to help the captain get promoted to [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] by assisting him in a decisive battle against the Rebels, which would prompt the Empire to promote Drusan for his hoped-for [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]. While acting as if [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had verified Esva&mdash;who posed as a fictitious [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo of the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial court]]&mdash;the captain had done so himself.<ref name="Choices" />

===Enter Nuso Esva===
{{Quote|We're charging the turbolaser batteries now.''"<br />"''Excellent. ''[&hellip;]'' In the meantime, may I request you shunt all other available power to the tractor beams and pull&mdash;''"<br />"''Not a good idea, my lord. ''[&hellip;]'' At this range, a full-power tractor beam could severely damage your hull.''"<br />"''That you shunt all power to the tractor beams, ''[&hellip;]'' and pull the two endmost attackers toward you.''"<br />"''Oh. Yes. Yes, I understand. Ensign Caln, tractors on the two endmost raiders&mdash;lock up, and reel in.|Captain Calo Drusan and Warlord Nuso Esva, posing as Lord Odo|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Obroa_system.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer ''Chimaera'', which Captain Calo Drusan commanded.]]
While the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} captain criticized the capabilities of [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] because of their assignment of the Star Destroyer to passenger duty, Esva's [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]], the ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'', jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], [[Third bridge officer]], noted that the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]{{'s}} speed was significant and advised Drusan to sound a [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] alarm. After six [[Starship/Legends|starships]] affiliated with Esva's [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]] appeared, the captain did as advised and charged the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. Through [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]], Esva ordered his ally to divert all power to the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] and pull the last two attacks toward the ''Chimaera'', allowing the ''Salaban's Hope'' to destroy them while the Star Destroyer took care of the others.<ref name="Choices" />

The ''Salaban's Hope'' then [[Hangar/Legends|docked]] with Drusan's ship, and the captain ordered Pellaeon to greet their guests, as he was busy. After Esva and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Sorro]], had received their quarters and been welcomed by Pellaeon, Drusan announced to all senior bridge officers&mdash;including his [[Executive officer/Legends|first]], [[Senior Commander/Legends|Senior Commander]] [[Grondarle]]&mdash;that the warlord was in absolute command of the ''Chimaera'' as part of a special [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|assignment]]. Esva then ordered the ''Chimaera'' to the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]], where, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]], he was to obtain some special equipment. After the material was obtained, Drusan delayed their departure from Wroona because he wished to make sure Esva's errand had been completed. It was, and the warlord commanded him to speak to the helm immediately, advising Drusan to follow his every command. Shortly after, Pellaeon assisted Esva in his move to his new [[Nuso Esva's quarters|quarters]] closer to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], where Drusan was waiting for the pair. Upon their arrival, the captain dismissed the commander.<ref name="Choices" />

After determining that Esva could be a member of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] species because he quoted an Arkanian legend, the ''[[Song of Salaban]]'', Pellaeon shared his findings with his captain. Drusan was impressed by the other's findings, and confirmed the commander's suspicions: Esva was an Arkanian and the order to carry him around had come from the Outer Rim, specifically from the Imperial Star Destroyer ''[[Predominant]]''. The captain claimed the order had come from Palpatine himself and shared that the warlord had been ordered aboard the ''Chimaera'' to look into a possible alliance between the Rebellion and Esva himself. Ordering Pellaeon not to tell any of what he had said to the commander, Drusan once again dismissed him. Shortly after, the ''Chimaera'' briefly visited the Poln system before heading into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Drusan then told Pellaeon of what they would be doing in the Unknown Regions: [[Engagement at Teptixii|hunting]] down one of Esva's [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|attack squadrons]] alongside Imperial [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']].<ref name="Choices" />

===Teptixii and the murder of Calo Drusan===
{{Quote|Sir, Captain Drusan's been killed, and I think Lord Odo is the one who murdered him.''"<br />"''His name isn't Odo, Commander. ''[&hellip;]'' The man in the mask is Warlord Nuso Esva.|Commander Gilad Pellaeon and Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:AdmiralAlienAndCaptainMustache.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Commander Gilad Pellaeon (pictured; right) confronted Drusan in his dying moments.]]
Arriving at Teptixii, Drusan considered Task Force ''Admonitor''{{'s}} formation foolish, and set upon to correct it. Believing the ''Admonitor''{{'s}} Captain [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] to be risking his [[Task force/Legends|task force's]] two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] and four [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]], the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} commander advised the other captain to pull back his [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]; however, Esva disagreed, telling Drusan that putting the cruisers in front of the ''Admonitor'' shielded the Star Destroyer from the firepower of Esva's main ships, the [[Firekiln]] warships, whose firepower was significant. The warlord also explained that by shielding the ''Admonitor'' with the other ships, Parck was able to lower his flagship's shields for a long enough period of time so that he could destroy one of the Storm-hair's other vessels. Drusan then ordered his crew to set the ''Chimaera'' to flank Esva's attack squadron, and Esva remarked that that would not be what the Star Destroyer would be doing. Instead, under the warlord's directive, it angled thirty degrees portside to divide the Firekilns' screening ships, prompting them to flee to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Esva, seeking to bring Parck's superior, [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], to the Poln system, ordered the captain to travel to the Poln system. As Parck refused, Drusan threatened to invoke [[Directive One-Oh-Three]] before a transmission reached both the ''Chimaera'' and the ''Admonitor''. The message instructed both warships to travel to Poln to respond to an [[Battle for Poln Major|insurrection]], with Drusan sending his ship there.<ref name="Choices" />

Once they arrived, Drusan was angered when a [[Unidentified sensor officer (Chimaera)|sensor officer]] informed Pellaeon that a [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]], the ''[[Lost Reef]]'', had been following the ''Chimaera'' since they departed from Poln before the Teptixii engagement. The captain stated that Esva believed it was one of his agents or the warlord himself, and ordered Pellaeon to find the Storm-hair, as he was expected to have joined the captain by that [[Time/Legends|time]]. However, the commander had no chance to tell his captain, as Esva sabotaged the ''Chimaera'' and incapacitated Drusan himself. While the captain died, Pellaeon confronted him and learnt why Drusan had verified the warlord. Drusan's hoped-for victory over the Rebellion did not arrive, with Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] being [[Battle of the Poln system|shattered]] shortly after the captain's death by Imperial and Rebel forces.<ref name="Choices" /> Eventually, Admiral [[Horst Strage]] became the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} captain.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The safety of this ship, the fleet, and the Empire is the business of all Imperial officers. ''[&hellip;]'' So are persistence and initiative. Well done, Commander. The fleet needs more officers like you.|Captain Calo Drusan praises Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Captain Calo Drusan was an impatient male who was willing to lie to his officers and crew to obtain a promotion.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calo Drusan appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
